visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Comprehension Instead of a Loop with append
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A loop with an if and append collects the long words in upper case. Use a list comprehension. The output must stay the same.

solution.code:
words = ["apple", "fig", "kiwi", "banana"]
long_upper = [w.upper() for w in words if len(w) > 3]
print(long_upper)
solution.explanation: The comprehension says what the new list contains (upper-cased long words) instead of describing how to fill it, with no empty list to create and no append calls.
